name: Mother India - 02 GSC SEO Opportunity Engine

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$json.rows||[]; return rows.map(r=>{const q=r.keys?.[0]||'',p=r.keys?.[1]||'',i=+r.impressions||0,c=+r.clicks||0,ctr=+r.ctr||0,pos=+r.position||99,intent=/(order|delivery|near me|restaurant|takeout|pickup|menu|catering|lunch|dinner|butter chicken|roti|biryani|paneer|tikka)/i.test(q)?1.5:1,rank=pos>=4&&pos<=15?(16-pos)/12:.15,score=i<50?0:Math.round((Math.log10(i+10)*35+Math.max(0,.06-ctr)*500+rank*30)*intent);return {json:{query:q,page:p,impressions:i,clicks:c,ctr,position:pos,opportunityScore:score,action:score>=140?'Priority: optimize title/meta and landing page':score>=90?'Improve CTR/content alignment':'Monitor'}}}).filter(x=>x.json.opportunityScore>0).sort((a,b)=>b.json.opportunityScore-a.json.opportunityScore).slice(0,50);
